description:
Same as [[surfaceType]], but returns texture path to ground texture as string.
{{Feature|informative|The texture returned is of the ground, even if there is a road at that position. To get road texture use [[getRoadInfo]] command.}}
examples:
<sqf>
private _pos = getPosATL player;
_pos set [2, true]; // use layer mask
private _groundTexture = surfaceTexture _pos;
</sqf>
name: surfaceTexture

Item.desc: world x coordinate of the position
Item.name: x

Item.desc: world y coordinate of the position
Item.name: y

Item.desc: When a number is provided (Z in 3D positions), it is ignored. When a boolean is provided, it defines whether the layer mask should be used. Using the layer mask is more accurate but slightly slower.
Item.name: useLayerMask
